scientific_conclusions.scope_limit: Offline SIMULATED multi-distance (d in {3, 5, 7}) space-time DEM + exact polynomial-time MWPM study (0 QPU seconds, provider_job_id=None). Establishes simulated circuit-level thresholds and Lambda_d suppression across published ibm_fez, SPAM-drifted ibm_fez, and Quantinuum H2-1 noise specifications; note that [[49,1,7]] (97Q) exceeds physical H2-1 (56Q) capacity and represents a Helios-scale QCCD noise projection, while non-computational |2> leakage and live QPU multi-distance execution remain separate.
